review_verification.method: Each photo extracted only from its .bwb7ce review container; source alt names reviewer. All 20 visible attachments across 8 selected reviews compared in labelled contact sheet. Exact individual permalink extracted from that review share metadata. Five gold SVG stars observed for each review.
review_verification.excerpt_policy: At most 25 words per individual review; exact contiguous excerpts, no edited wording.
review_verification.image_processing: Same photo identity requested at =s800; HTTP success and decoded image confirmed; optimized WebP, no compositing or reviewer reassignment.
review_verification.date_policy: Only Google relative date labels retained; exact posting dates not inferred.

forms: Both forms are preview-only: native validation and local status message; no transmission, storage, endpoint or success redirect. No tracking identifiers.

publication.method: Dedicated repository; GitHub Pages from main root with .nojekyll. No other client repository or hosting configuration is part of this publication.

checks: All 16 rendered image instances decoded successfully.
No horizontal page overflow at observed CSS viewport widths 350, 390, 427, 1363 and 1577.
Carousel smoke passed at CSS widths 350 and 1363: one/three full cards, neighboring peeks, arrows and Home/End boundaries.
Both preview forms reject empty required fields; valid synthetic input cancels transmission, leaves storage and URL unchanged, and displays an explicit nothing-sent status.
Internal CTA anchors resolve; phone links use the Google number except the explicitly labelled website alternative.
No iframe or external tracking scripts; browser console reported no messages.
Desktop and mobile hero/review screenshots visually inspected.
verification.note: Orca browser zoom changes CSS viewport width relative to requested capture width. Native desktop capture avoids emulated-viewport screenshot tiling. Carousel smoke waits for settled scroll geometry rather than checking during animation.
